def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    # Regions are separated by the full-width/full-height marker lines.
    rbounds = [-1] + hlines + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vlines + [w]
    rsegments = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1)]
    csegments = [(cbounds[i]+1, cbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # Select the panel carrying the pattern (rather than an empty background panel).
    panels = [(sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)), a,b,x,y)
              for a,b in rsegments for x,y in csegments]
    _, sa,sb,sx,sy = max(panels)
    tile = [row[sx:sy] for row in grid[sa:sb]]
    th, tw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if r in hlines: continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c in vlines: continue
            out[r][c] = tile[(r-sa) % th][(c-sx) % tw]
    return out
